manifest.name: @local/profile-sync
manifest.author: lukeliu
manifest.description: Export, merge-restore, and privately sync this profile's selected plugins and configuration.

readme.text:
English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Export this DeepSeek Harness profile's selected plugins and configuration, then merge that snapshot into another machine. The same snapshot can be stored in a private GitHub repository through the GitHub CLI.

Sessions, credentials, and settings that exist only on the destination stay untouched. A snapshot that contains a secret value is refused. Names of environment variables, such as `apiKeyEnv`, are kept because they are not the secrets themselves.

This package is a community plugin. DeepSeek Harness does not accept external plugins into its own repository; install it from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin install git+https://github.com/lukebest/dsh-plugin-profile-sync.git
```

It can also be installed from Plugins with the same Git address.

To browse it from Discover, add this index:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukebest/dsh-plugin-profile-sync/main/index.json
```

Open Settings, then Plugins, then Sync.

- Export downloads a JSON snapshot.
- Choose a snapshot and Restore merges it into the current profile.
- Enter `owner/name` to save a private GitHub repository, push the current snapshot, or merge the snapshot stored there.

`gh` must be installed and signed in before GitHub sync. The repository is created as private when it does not exist. A public repository is refused. The snapshot is saved as `profiles/<profile>.json`.
The `profile_sync` tool exposes the same export, restore, and GitHub actions.
